status_legend.fulltext: opened and substantive source text inspected
status_legend.abstract: opened landing/abstract and claim limited to that evidence
status_legend.partial: opened but only metadata/search/limited text inspected
status_legend.unavailable: actual open attempt failed or was blocked
status_legend.not-opened: note reviewed from original catalog; not opened in this research pass

verified_new_sources.title: WWC Organizing Instruction and Study to Improve Student Learning
verified_new_sources.claim: Seven recommendations include spacing, worked examples, graphics plus verbal descriptions, abstract-concrete integration, retrieval practice, delayed judgments, and deep explanatory questions.

verified_new_sources.title: Generative AI without guardrails can harm learning
verified_new_sources.claim: High-school math RCT: GPT-assisted practice improved practice performance but unassisted exam performance could fall; single school/topic and short-term limits are explicit.

verified_new_sources.title: AI tutoring outperforms in-class active learning
verified_new_sources.claim: Search result and abstract: crossover RCT in Harvard introductory physics; a carefully scaffolded tutor improved measured learning and engagement versus active learning. Direct Nature PDF was blocked; use abstract-level claims only.

verified_new_sources.title: GOV.UK headings
verified_new_sources.claim: Semantic heading hierarchy, sentence case, and captions are legitimate information architecture; visual variation is allowed only with accessibility testing.

verified_new_sources.title: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.6 Headings and Labels
verified_new_sources.claim: Headings/labels should describe topic or purpose; semantic markup and descriptive content are separate requirements.

verified_new_sources.title: CLDR 34 French locale migration
verified_new_sources.claim: French grouping separator changed from NBSP U+00A0 to narrow NBSP U+202F; locale formatting is not evidence of authorship or AI provenance.

verified_new_sources.title: Interrogating Design Homogenization in Web Vibe Coding
verified_new_sources.claim: Research frames frictionless vibe coding as a possible homogenization mechanism and recommends productive friction; no population prevalence estimate.

verified_new_sources.title: What Makes a Good Generated Image?
verified_new_sources.claim: Human and multimodal-LLM image-quality attribute relationships differ; evaluate aesthetics, artifacts, anatomy, composition, adherence, and style separately.

verified_new_sources.title: T2VTextBench
verified_new_sources.claim: Ten text-to-video systems show poor and unstable on-screen text fidelity and temporal consistency.

verified_new_sources.title: DEVIL dynamics evaluation
verified_new_sources.claim: Low-dynamics video can score well on consistency metrics; dynamics-aware metrics align better with human ratings on the benchmark.

verified_new_sources.title: Re-FRAME meeting summarization
verified_new_sources.claim: Fact extraction and reader-specific questions reduce omission/hallucination in benchmark meeting summaries.

verified_new_sources.title: What’s Wrong? Refining Meeting Summaries
verified_new_sources.claim: ACL paper releases 200-summary error dataset covering omission, irrelevance, and structural errors.

verified_new_sources.title: AI-Generated Slides: Are They Good? Can Students Tell?
verified_new_sources.claim: Curated and edited AI slides in one course were rated comparably to instructor slides; students could not reliably identify origin.

verified_new_sources.title: From Text to Map
verified_new_sources.claim: LLM causal-loop diagram recovered 56% of human-coded relationships; authors require human verification of each relationship and sign.

verified_new_sources.title: How LLMs Distort Our Written Language
verified_new_sources.claim: Even grammar-only prompts can alter semantics; generated peer reviews showed different weighting and higher scores.

verified_new_sources.title: Voice Under Revision
verified_new_sources.claim: LLM editing pulls personal narrative toward a polished, less situated register; author-baseline comparison is preferable to universal word bans.

verified_new_sources.title: When AI Writes, Who Gets Cited?
verified_new_sources.claim: Models share citation-selection preferences not seen in blinded domain experts, supporting citation monoculture audits.

verification_boundary: All original source notes screened. Only recorded tool-opened sources have a live status other than not-opened. Abstract or landing-page access does not verify the full paper or all catalog claims.

access_status_meanings.not-opened: No live access recorded in this inventory; note screening only.
access_status_meanings.abstract: Abstract or publication landing page read; no complete paper verification.
access_status_meanings.fulltext: Substantive source text accessed; individual claims still require alignment review.
access_status_meanings.partial: Only selected sections, metadata, or limited access.
access_status_meanings.unavailable: Open attempt failed; catalog note not treated as verified.
